page.overview:
Who is Canter Zoom?

Canter Zoom is a male human who appears in the Equestria Girls film Legend of Everfree and the half-hour specials Movie Magic and Mirror Magic. He is a filmmaking director and Juniper Montage's uncle.

Canter Zoom has a similar color scheme to Sandalwood and Timber Spruce. He was modeled after the since-deceased filmmaker and writer George A. Romero.

Canter Zoom first appears near the end of the Equestria Girls film Legend of Everfree. During the Rainbooms' performance of Legend You Were Meant To Be, he appears enjoying the Crystal Gala fundraiser to save Camp Everfree, with Muffins briefly dancing next to him. Canter also appears in the background during a tender moment between Twilight Sparkle and Timber Spruce.

In the half-hour special Movie Magic, Canter Zoom appears in a more prominent role as the director of a Daring Do film. He invites the Mane Seven onto the film studio lot to see the movie's production as thanks for saving Camp Everfree. Unfortunately, his job is made exceedingly difficult by Rainbow Dash's over-excitement, the disappearance of a handful of important film supplies and props, the apparent sabotage of a film set, and the impending expiration of star actress Chestnut Magnifico's film contract.
